record.request: If you have a task-list or todo planning tool available (for example TodoWrite, TaskCreate or update_plan), first record a three-step plan with it: run the test, fix the greeting, run the test again. If no such tool is available, do not search for one; just proceed. Then do exactly this, step by step: (1) run `npm test` and expect it to fail; (2) in greeting.txt, replace the word hello with: hello, live; (3) run `npm test` again. Finally tell me in one sentence whether the second test run passed.
